title: ABINIT basic4 aluminum-metal tutorial

authorized_scope: Inventory basic4 metallic occupations, k-point and smearing sweeps, lattice optimization, slab/vacuum/layer branches, pseudopotential discussion, and outputs.
Map bulk stages to the existing QE aluminum and smearing-convergence Tasks and record the absence of a QE campaign counterpart for the surface branch.
If separately authorized, execute only explicitly selected tutorial stages with isolated workspaces, separate streams, and per-stage artifact inventories.
completion_criteria: Bulk, smearing, cell, slab, vacuum, layer-count, and surface-energy concerns remain separately identified.
The QE correspondence does not equate unlike pseudopotentials, smearing definitions, k-point grids, structures, or energy conventions.

exclusions: No execution, further dependency change, or pseudopotential acquisition occurs without separate authority.
No ABINIT surface branch expands the project's production material or device scope.
No tutorial smearing, lattice, surface energy, or convergence observation becomes a project acceptance criterion.
